tools.title: System Junk
tools.subtitle: Clean up caches, logs, temporary files and leftovers of apps you already removed.
points: Frees up space for things that matter
Never touches your documents

tools.title: Installers
tools.subtitle: Find leftover .dmg, .pkg, .iso, .xip and .zip installers you no longer need.
points: Lists every installer with its size
You pick what goes

tools.title: Project Junk
tools.subtitle: Remove rebuildable build folders: node_modules, target, build, dist and more.
points: Lists projects touched in the last 7 days but leaves them unticked
Protects Git-tracked files

tools.title: Developer Tools
tools.subtitle: Give back space held by Docker, Xcode's iOS Simulators and the Android SDK, with their own cleanup commands.
points: Runs Docker's and Xcode's own commands
Nothing runs until you press Clean

tools.title: Optimization
tools.subtitle: Refresh system caches and services, and repair safe maintenance issues.
points: Rebuilds stale system databases
Only applies safe, reversible fixes

tools.title: Startup Items
tools.subtitle: See what starts when you log in, turn off what you do not need, and which apps hold privacy permissions.
points: Turned-off items go to the Trash
System items are shown, never changed

tools.title: Slim Apps
tools.subtitle: Remove the Intel code from universal apps on Apple Silicon.
points: Each app is verified before it is replaced
The original goes to the Trash

tools.title: Large & Old Files
tools.subtitle: Find big files you have not opened for months, and old screenshots on the Desktop.
points: Looks only in your own folders
Everything goes to the Trash

tools.title: Duplicates
tools.subtitle: Find files whose contents are exactly the same, and keep one copy of each.
points: Compares every byte, not just names
The oldest copy stays

tools.title: Touch ID for sudo
tools.subtitle: Use your fingerprint instead of typing your password in Terminal.
points: One-time setup
Easy to turn off again
